translation.title: Sodium Hyaluronate Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used to promote tissue regeneration of painless wounds.
translation.usage: Apply it to the wound area 2 to 3 times a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it. If your symptoms persist or worsen, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
